fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld+html) combine metadata from the page's NewsArticle JSON-LD block with a body reconstructed from the .tjp-single__content HTML (JSON-LD carries no articleBody/description here). Latest-mode records (S2-sitemap) carry title/link-style fields from the Google News sitemap.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld+html or S2-sitemap).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

description.title: Description
description.description: Article description, read from the og:description meta tag (JSON-LD carries no description field) (article-mode).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, reconstructed from .tjp-single__content paragraphs including the drop-cap opening sentence (article-mode).

author.title: Author
author.description: Comma-joined byline name(s), flattened from the JSON-LD author list/dict (article-mode).

image.title: Image URL
image.description: Lead image URL, flattened from the JSON-LD image object (article-mode).

_paywalled.title: Paywalled
_paywalled.description: True when the JSON-LD isAccessibleForFree flag is the string 'false' (article-mode).

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline from the Google News sitemap (latest-mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
